selection_rationale: Precision round for the 15 training compact-16 mothers (original fate campaign): 32 additional independent clones of the original arm, pooled with the existing 16 to 48 clones per mother. Completes the 50-mother compact precision picture (these mothers were used for model fitting, so descriptor associations on them are discovery-level, not confirmation). No arm comparisons here.
interpretation: clone-count augmentation for per-mother risk estimation; no intervention claims
